title: Dreamina Pricing 2026: Plans, Credits and Costs
summary: Dreamina pricing structures determine your monthly credit allowance and access to high-resolution generation tools.
body_markdown:
## Monday morning plan for new users


Dreamina is CapCut's AI image and video app. You can maximize its value by treating the free tier as a daily testing ground for prompt engineering before committing to a paid subscription.


The free plan has a set number of daily credits that reset every 24 hours, which means users must pace their usage to avoid running out before the next cycle.


When you exhaust your balance on a Sunday night, you can resume high-resolution iterations the following morning without spending a cent.


This daily refresh cycle allows for low-stakes experimentation with Grok Imagine Video 1.5 for cinematic clips or Gemini Omni Flash for video editing tasks. By the time you upgrade, you've already mastered the syntax required to avoid wasting paid credits on failed generations.


A solo creator testing the waters uses the Free plan, which offers daily credits for image and video generation but limits high-resolution exports and adds a watermark to videos.


### Dreamina Pro Monthly plan for freelancers


A freelance editor producing regular social content fits the Basic plan at $15.00 a month, so they can manage their budget with a predictable, recurring expense. This tier removes watermarks and increases the monthly credit pool to handle client revisions.


Polished assets reach the client without platform branding or production bottlenecks. **A professional studio requiring consistent output should choose the Pro Yearly plan at $179.99 a year.**


### Dreamina annual plan savings explained


By choosing the annual rate, you lower the effective monthly cost by 33% compared to the month-to-month rate. This allows you to maximize your budget over the long term.


The transition from a monthly commitment to an annual one is driven by the need for predictable overhead in a high-volume production environment. The annual subscription is a significant discount if you've moved past the experimentation phase.


### Dreamina annual plan for commercial video work


It is ideal if you require a steady stream of high-definition, watermark-free assets for commercial projects. While the monthly renewal provides flexibility for short-term campaigns, the annual plan stabilizes the cost-per-video for long-term YouTube or marketing growth.


### Automating Dreamina to Frame.io review workflow


Once the generation process is complete, you'll typically use an automated workflow to move files from Dreamina to Frame.io, Adobe's video review tool, for client approval. This handoff ensures that the time saved by AI generation isn't lost to manual upload and download cycles.
